title: 香蕉棒球Jesse Cole：这是超级碗加摔角狂热，冠军赛前先来11分钟表演
speaker: Jesse Cole

segments.en: This is Super Bowl, WrestleMania. I mean we're doing a show with original performances. We got tons of guest stars. We are going over the top
segments.zh: 这是超级碗加摔角狂热。我们做原创表演秀，有大量客串明星，我们就是要做到极致。

segments.en: It's every single happening. There will be something and so it's it's commercial free. It's at free we are giving it all and literally I mean it's
segments.zh: 每个瞬间都在发生事情，总会有惊喜。没有广告，完全免费，我们倾其所有。

segments.en: Ten new performances. I mean it is over the top. So it is entertainment. That's what we are. That's the business we're in but they're also competing for a championship and right before they win the championship
segments.zh: 十个新表演，做到极致。这就是娱乐，这就是我们，这就是我们的行业。但他们也在争夺冠军，就在夺冠之前……

segments.en: There's gonna be 11 and 11 minute performance on the field. It's like oh no forget about the chairs from now. We're gonna do a 11-minute show for everyone and that's what it's all about. We want to give fans something that you know it's really remarkable and unforgettable
segments.zh: 场上会有11分钟表演。就像，别管椅子了，我们要给大家来一场11分钟的秀。这就是意义所在，我们想给粉丝真正非凡、难忘的东西。
